meta.title: Datasets
meta.description: What Pool4ward knows about the ground — intermodal services, carriers, charging points, networks — and how far: coverage, freshness, limits on what is shown.

hero.title: What we know about the ground — and how far.
hero.lede: The globe shows the richness of our datasets without handing out their content: concentration areas and generalised corridors, never the list of assets.

explore.title: The ground, layer by layer.
explore.lede: Two layers at a time, at most. A click, or the zone selector, opens the summary of a territory.

items.name: Referenced is not available.
items.body: An actor or a service listed in a dataset does not necessarily have free capacity on your corridor. The globe shows the “referenced” level; availability is confirmed by a written reply.

items.name: Areas, not points.
items.body: Layers are concentrations aggregated at a mesh of several degrees, and generalised corridors. No exact position, no vehicle tracked.

items.name: Coverage is displayed.
items.body: Each layer says whether it is connected, what it covers and how old it is. What is not covered stays empty: we do not fill it in.

protection.title: Make the richness visible without handing out the database.
protection.lede: Anything a browser displays can be captured, including as an image. We know it: that is why we limit what is shown rather than promise the impossible.

tiers.name: Private datasets
tiers.body: Source data, contacts, qualifications, precise coordinates. No access from this site.

tiers.name: Public projection
tiers.body: Aggregates and images generated server-side, at a capped mesh and zoom: acceptable even if copied in full.

tiers.name: Detailed exploration
tiers.body: Reserved for an authorised account, bounded in results, filters and cumulative volume. Not connected in this preview.

protection.limit: Residual risk: the summaries you can see remain capturable. They do not allow the database, or the precision of the private data, to be reconstructed.

coverage.title: What each layer contains today.
coverage.lede: In this preview, layers are demonstration projections: their shape illustrates the mechanism, not the real coverage of the datasets.
coverage.legendNote: The mesh is the smallest area that can be told apart: nothing finer is published.

cta.title: Need the detail?
cta.body: The detail of a dataset is consulted with an authorised account, as part of a conversation about your scope.

Globe.label: Datasets globe

banner.demo: Demonstration data: these layers illustrate the mechanism; they do not come from Pool4ward’s datasets.

services.name: Intermodal services and terminals
services.body: Rail, inland waterway, shortsea, deepsea: areas where services and terminals are referenced.

carriers.name: Carriers
carriers.body: Referenced areas of presence. Does not locate any vehicle and says nothing about availability.

parkings.name: Secure parking
parkings.body: Areas where secure parking sites are referenced.

charging.name: Heavy-duty electric charging
charging.body: Concentration areas of charging infrastructure, with heavy-duty relevance qualified.

networks.name: Rail and inland waterway networks
networks.body: Generalised, schematic corridors: they represent neither a real route nor a service.

controls.layersHelp: Two at most: choosing a third removes the oldest.
controls.map: Interactive globe: drag to rotate, wheel or buttons to zoom. Zone selection is also available in the list.

states.noWebgl: Your browser does not display 3D rendering: here is the flat map, with the same layers.
states.lost: 3D rendering stopped: the flat map takes over.
states.software: Your device renders 3D in software: the flat map is smoother and shows the same layers.
states.sourceError: A layer could not be loaded. The others remain available.
states.tooMany: Too many requests in a short time: the globe slows down. Please wait a moment.
states.sessionError: Could not open the globe session. Please try again in a moment.
states.manifestError: The globe is not available right now.
states.notConnected: The projection is not connected on this environment.

poster.label: Preview of the globe: the interactive rendering loads on demand.

zonePanel.title: Zone summary
zonePanel.none: No zone selected. Click the globe or choose a zone in the list.
zonePanel.error: This zone’s summary could not be loaded.
zonePanel.suppressed: Hidden: count too small to be described.
zonePanel.note: Summaries are ranges, never the list of assets. Detail requires authorised access.
zonePanel.noLayer: Show a layer to read its summary.

Globe.legendNote: Base map: Natural Earth (public domain). Layers are images generated server-side from aggregated data.
